newsitem.title: UK: Card Clear says agrees U.S. acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Card Clear says agrees U.S. acquisition.

text.p: Card payment and fraud prevention company Card Clear Plc said on Tuesday it had agreed terms in principle to acquire Transaction Billing Resources Inc (TBR) of the U.S. which provides credit card fraud prevention services to the telecoms industry.
The deal is subject to due diligence and is anticipated to be completed in May.
The offer values TBR at between $10 and $11 million. At least half the purchase price is to be made up of Card Clear shares.

Card Clear said the transaction was in line with its policy of growth through selective earnings-enhancing acquisitions. It said TBR's services are complementary to Card Clear's core business and had potential for significant future growth.
